summary: A prepared statement in the PostgreSQL visibility plugin's GetFromVisibility function is not properly closed, causing a resource leak on every GetWorkflowExecution call.
userImpact: Memory leaks and potential database connection exhaustion accumulate with each visibility query, degrading system stability.
rootCause: Prepared statement created in GetFromVisibility is not explicitly closed after query execution.
keyQuote: Created prepared statement is not closed. So every call to GetWorkflowExecution on vis path will leak prepared statement.
